name: Allosaurus
description: A large carnivorous theropod dinosaur known from the Morrison Formation.

name: Allosaurus fragilis
description: A large predatory dinosaur from the Morrison Formation. Cleveland-Lloyd is especially notable for its unusually dense concentration of Allosaurus fossils.

name: Stegosaurus
description: A plated herbivorous dinosaur known from the Late Jurassic Morrison Formation.

name: Coelophysis
description: A small, lightweight carnivorous dinosaur from the Late Triassic, famously known from the Ghost Ranch fossil locality.

name: Tyrannosaurus rex
description: One of the best-known large predatory dinosaurs of the Late Cretaceous, represented by fossils from the Hell Creek Formation.

name: Triceratops
description: A large herbivorous dinosaur with three horns, known from Late Cretaceous rocks including the Lance Formation.
